Author: pyreymo
Name: Event Horizon
Description: Cull distant or irrelevant world objects around your character. Use /eventhorizon or /eh to open settings.
Changelog:
- Added a targeting-me marker that can highlight players targeting you with a native nameplate marker and optional VFX, including style controls for placement, scale, opacity, glow, and color.
- Added an experimental hidden-player ground marker and updated VFX handling so hidden-player effects are tracked, updated, and cleaned up more reliably.
- Reworked the player visibility planner and reconciliation path to reduce expensive refresh work, smooth fade/show transitions, and make visibility changes more predictable under player-count pressure.
- Reorganized behavior settings into clearer sections with collapsed advanced controls, refreshed English and Chinese copy, and kept compact DTR controls for FPS and background styling.
- Fixed the experimental DTR background lifecycle so it tears down safely when the DTR addon, chat log skin, bounds, or login state are unavailable, preventing stale native nodes after returning to the title screen.
